rules.statement: This synthetic core0 unit starts with the pinned32-tile/16384-word SPD constructor state and configured4-core MMIO mapping, quiescent initialized signed-int32 RF values0/1/1 at registers0/1/2, and one registered initialized64-byte aligned normal-memory input line whose virtual base is nonzero, with stable synchronous fault-free translation and coherent no-interference visibility through normal return. These are conditional environment/source-model premises owned by the Probata proof-semantics maintainer, pending Yan-Ru freeze review (59); alloc/init do not establish them and arbitrary callers or physical boot are not established.

rules.statement: All three MMIO helpers and this source unit are interpreted only on normal return; no termination, fairness or hardware-liveness theorem is claimed.

rules.statement: An acknowledgement establishes dispatch, not completion or still-unfinished hardware. In this isolated no-observation/no-interference caller, unobserved device events may be represented by a logically uncovered command and settled only at the returned real ready read; this source-model correspondence is owned by the Probata proof-semantics maintainer, pending Yan-Ru freeze review (59). All-schedule event refinement and contract/body agreement remain unverified owned TCB duties, not conclusions of finite native prefixes.
For defined signed-int RF0/1/1, the nonempty u32 stream has one lane; a matched completed response sets starting-tile size1 before Finished/ready restoration.
